title: Cover Banner (X / LinkedIn)
prompt: A wide social cover banner for Ongea Pesa, a voice-first African fintech. Deep near-black teal canvas (#0A1A1F) stretching wide. On the left third: the glowing orbital emblem with the 'ONGEA PESA' wordmark beside it (white, geometric uppercase). Sweeping across the full width behind the type, a luminous soundwave/orbit line flows from green to cyan (#34D399 to #22D3EE), like a spoken word traveling across the banner and resolving into a bright point on the right. Tagline small near the wordmark: 'The bank that listens.' Bottom-right corner, tiny: 'by NSAIT'. Cinematic, minimal, lots of negative space, premium. Keep key elements clear of the far-left avatar safe zone.
negative_prompt: purple background, microphone, dollar sign, stock people, clutter, lots of text, lorem ipsum, neon, low-res, distorted text

params.safe_zones: avatar overlaps lower-left on some platforms

notes: Render at 3:1 then export 1500x500. Keep text out of the lower-left where the avatar sits.
